description: This file contains a static class 'StorageEmulator' that acts as a wrapper for managing the Azure Storage Emulator. It provides methods to check if the emulator is started, start or stop the emulator, check if it exists, and retrieve help information. The class interacts with system processes to manage the emulator based on process names and executable paths.

classes.name: StorageEmulator
classes.description: A static utility class providing control over the Azure Storage Emulator, including starting, stopping, checking its status, and retrieving help information.

methods.name: IsStarted
methods.description: Checks if the storage emulator process is currently running.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Determines if the Storage Emulator is installed, by checking the executable path.

methods.name: Help
methods.description: Retrieves help information from the Storage Emulator process if it is running.

methods.name: TryStart
methods.description: Attempts to start the storage emulator if it exists.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the storage emulator process if it is not already running.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the storage emulator process if it is running.
